body:
before breakfast: the crop trial crew brought rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the buses quit running.

There was a place for a signature and no one willing to write one. I used the margin to note what we actually found.

Someone had to finish the household list even though the office had closed. I wrote the names in the space left for expenses.
title: Before breakfast: rinsed gloves
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
